name: Zack D Studio
intro: Zack D Studio turns a single question into a short video, with a script, characters, keyframes, clips and a final cut. Here's how the controls are laid out.

features.templates: Templates load a ready-made starting point, either a script only or a finished project. Loading one is a quick way to start, or to see how a complete project looks.
features.pipeline-button: The pipeline button is your guide. Its label always shows the next step, from writing the script to rendering the final cut, so you never hunt for what comes next.
features.approve-script: Your script appears as editable beat cards. Fix the story first, then approve it, which locks in the plan before anything is made for characters, keyframes or clips.
features.burn-captions: Under the final cut, Free Captions transcribes your video on your device, lets you fix any words and pick a look, then renders the captions into the video. It uses no credits.

outro: That's Zack D Studio. Edit your script before you approve it, and let the pipeline button walk you through the rest.
